what: A 41×41 dot grid (10×10 board) grows only where the text image board (default 「50」) is bright to form the text, and each dot draws one pattern piece (circle · donut · three dots · diamond · grid · check · antenna · square · arrow — six colors rotating the hue wheel from the accent color). Behind it a gray piece layer (circle · star · square) follows offset by (.4, -.3, -.1) like a shadow. When opened, from the scattered spot on a radius 3 sphere (morph .7) the dots gather into the text over 1.6s power2.out, and dot size ripples .5~1.5x with noise on an 80bpm tempo (sine.inOut within a beat). While the dot that follows the cursor position by .4 per frame is changing (about 1 second even after the cursor stops), dots grow .08 at a time toward it and, once fully caught up, shrink back .08 at a time by a size × 1.2 amount, the dots scatter outward from that spot and the camera tilts .3 (WebGL · settles in about .95s after a sweep)

options.text: Letters the dots will form (picture board), default 50 — font is --kf-font-display
options.morph: Initial scatter amount (0 letters · 1 sphere), default .7
options.intro: If on, gathers morph to 0 when opened, if off leaves it as is and the caller decides
options.y: Vertical position of the dot plate (world units, plate height 10), default 0 — at -5 only the top half of the text hangs below the screen
options.pointer: Cursor scatter and camera tilt on/off, default on (on touch it follows the finger press and drag position · off with reduced motion)
options.el.fxPoints.params: Handles the user’s script feeds morph·divergence·yOffset·cameraZ every frame (for scroll scenes)

note: three.cjs (CommonJS build) loads three-global.js from the same folder first and reads it as window.THREE (library/_vendor/three@0.162.0/build/three.cjs). The original is the morph particles of use-shader-fx (React), so the same shader flow (shape plate × point size · morph · divergence · tempo noise · map arrangement) was rewritten. The sphere positions are evenly spread over the sphere instead of icosahedron vertices. The points sit behind the content with no pointer-events

from.where: index.html .mc-canvas (patterned dots of ‹50› stuck to the screen — straddling below the Hero · rise with scroll, gather into a sphere, scatter, camera dives in, and turn back into letters at the footer)
